╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── step 3 of 5 ─╮
│                                                                              │
│  Your agent's key                                                            │
│                                                                              │
│  Your agent trades with a key of its own, made by Candle's CLI and stored    │
│  straight into the Candle Harness. It never shows on screen.                 │
│                                                                              │
│  Candle won't make a key yet: this account hasn't authorized its embedded    │
│  wallet for agents. A new account does this once, on Candle's site.          │
│                                                                              │
│  1  Open the Agent Console (the link below), signed in as this account.      │
│  2  Make a key there with Create key and authorize, and approve what Candle  │
│     asks. That authorizes the wallet.                                        │
│  3  Revoke that key if you like: the authorization stays. Then Try again     │
│     here.                                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│  ▸ Copy the Agent Console's link         ⧉ alpha.candle.tv/agents?tab=keys   │
│    Try again                            candle keys create --label agent-a   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
